title: Finite free $p$-Stam phase transition conjecture
statement:
For each $n\geq 3$, consider the $p$-Stam inequality for monic real-rooted pairs of degree $n$, with critical exponent denoted by $p^*$. **$p$-Stam phase transition conjecture.** For all $n\geq 3$, the $p$-Stam inequality holds for all monic real-rooted pairs if and only if

$$
p\in(1,2],
$$

so that $p^*=2$, independently of $n$. The paper proves failure at the Hermite pair for every $p>2$ and presents computational and analytic evidence for the threshold; validity throughout $(1,2]$ remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11922

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2026).
source_name: Baran Hashemi, “Spectral Structure in Finite Free Information Inequalities and p-Stam Phase Transitions”, arXiv:2604.11922 (2026).
